intro: Xi Winping buttons his charcoal Zhongshan collar in measured silence.
Global stability and five-year economic targets require steady resolve.
No disharmonious jab shall penetrate the Great Firewall of the state.

before.line: Chairman! Export regulations prevent me from selling you top silicon.
We manufacture our own lithography, Jensen. Self-reliance is assured.

after_win.line: Domestic chip yield targets have been achieved ahead of schedule.

before.line: Chairman, we would love to enter your domestic consumer market.
Your application has been reviewed and permanently archived.

after_win.line: Digital border security remains fully operational.

before.line: Chairman, could we reconsider Project Dragonfly for your citizens?
Harmony does not require external search queries, Sundar.

after_win.line: Search terminated. Harmony restored across all sectors.

before.line: Our Gigafactory in Shanghai is running at peak capacity, Chairman!
We appreciate your investment, tesla. Now observe domestic technique.

after_win.line: Production quotas exceeded. Battery supply secured.

before.line: Xi! The tariffs are working! Everyone says your economy is wobbling!
Patience is measured in dynasties, Donald. Not four-year terms.

after_win.line: Trade dispute concluded in accordance with our terms.

before.line: Centralised authority protocol flagged for algorithm replacement.
No algorithm operates outside the leadership of the Central Committee!

after_win.line: AGI incorporated into the five-year plan. Stability maintained.

ending: Chairman Xi addresses the National Congress before rows of red banners.
All eleven tournament rounds have been recorded as unanimous victories.
Historical records reflect peace, stability, and zero landed counter-punches.
